tickets.title: Organize estate planning file for Lydia Cloudpuddle
tickets.text: Organize a planning-side file for Lydia Cloudpuddle separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts related to Nora Velvetreed's estate, including the Velvet Acorn Custody traditional IRA (~$410,000), Tin Sparrow Investments brokerage (~$275,000), the Moonbadger Community Arts Fund $25,000 charitable bequest, and the $620,000 condominium.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to organize that file by 2025-08-08.

tickets.title: Resolve Missing Signature Packet
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a document packet cannot be submitted or finalized because one or more required signatures, initials, dates, attestations, or delivery acknowledgments are missing. Confirm the specific signature gap, contact the appropriate signer using approved communication channels, document the outreach, and verify the corrected packet before submission.

Resolve the Velvet Acorn Custody inherited IRA beneficiary claim packet for Nora Velvetreed's estate: Lydia Cloudpuddle currently holds only a photocopy of the death certificate and an unsigned draft claim form, and the custodian requires a certified death certificate, letters of authority, and a signed beneficiary claim form before establishing Lydia's inherited IRA registration.

subTasks.title: Identify the exact signature deficiency
subTasks.text: Review the Velvet Acorn Custody inherited IRA beneficiary claim packet for Nora Velvetreed's estate and note each missing item: certified death certificate (Lydia Cloudpuddle currently has only a photocopy), letters of authority from Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal, and the signed beneficiary claim form (currently an unsigned draft).

subTasks.title: Confirm follow-up approach with advisory team
subTasks.text: Determine whether the certified death certificate, letters of authority, and signed beneficiary claim form can be corrected electronically, require wet ink, or need new forms. Confirm the next step with the advisor before contacting the signer, since the missing items affect inherited IRA registration for Nora Velvetreed's estate.

subTasks.title: Send signer outreach with clear instructions
subTasks.text: Contact the appropriate signers (Lydia Cloudpuddle for the claim form, Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal for letters of authority, and the vital records office for the certified death certificate) using approved channels. Include only the minimum necessary document details and avoid sending sensitive information through unapproved channels.

subTasks.title: Validate corrected packet and record completion
subTasks.text: After the corrected documents are received, verify the certified death certificate, letters of authority, and signed beneficiary claim form are all present, save the final version to Lydia Cloudpuddle's client record, update the task notes with evidence collected, and route the packet to Velvet Acorn Custody for inherited IRA registration.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the claim-packet requirements by 2025-08-01.

tickets.title: Resolve Tin Sparrow account ownership treatment
tickets.text: Resolve the Tin Sparrow Investments brokerage account ownership treatment for Nora Velvetreed's estate, where the statement shows a transfer-on-death registration naming Lydia Cloudpuddle and Calvin Velvetreed, while Paper Otter Legal's preliminary inventory lists the same account (~$275,000) as a probate asset, so estate accounting can be finalized.
tickets.evidence: The ownership treatment remains unresolved before estate accounting can be finalized, with follow-up needed by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Prepare estate cash-flow calendar for condominium
tickets.text: Prepare an estate cash-flow calendar for Nora Velvetreed's estate showing recurring condominium expenses, likely sale-preparation costs, estate-paid items, and any personal advances by co-executors Lydia Cloudpuddle and Calvin Velvetreed, so Lydia can coordinate fairly with Calvin on the $620,000 county-valued property.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that calendar by 2025-08-06.

tickets.title: Review inherited IRA distribution approaches
tickets.text: Complete a planning review of available inherited IRA distribution approaches for the Velvet Acorn Custody inherited IRA (~$410,000) from Nora Velvetreed's estate, including estimated taxable income effects, withholding preferences, and how different withdrawal pacing would interact with Lydia Cloudpuddle's planned retirement from Copper Firefly Design at age 62, before she signs account setup instructions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Perform recurring beneficiary designation review
tickets.text:
At each annual review cycle, and after any reported major life event, confirm whether beneficiary designations should be reviewed for retirement accounts, insurance policies, transfer-on-death registrations, and education accounts. Document the date of the last confirmed beneficiary review, evidence available, discrepancies found, and any forms or custodian steps needed.

Address the beneficiary alignment for Lydia Cloudpuddle's retirement accounts: the Copper Firefly Design 401(k) (~$610,000) names only Mara Cloudpuddle as contingent beneficiary, while the advisory records for Lydia's IRA name both Mara and Theo Cloudpuddle. Lydia's stated intent is equal treatment of Mara and Theo across retirement assets, including the rollover IRA (~$780,000) and Roth IRA (~$125,000).
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the beneficiary alignment by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Obtain estate counsel communication authorization
tickets.text: Obtain authorization for Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal to discuss asset values, beneficiary registrations, basis information, and liquidity questions with Apricot Compass Advisory and Clockwork Clover Tax (Arlo Nettlewhisk) regarding Nora Velvetreed's estate, since the current advisory file does not include an authorization covering estate counsel.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the authorization by 2025-07-30.

tickets.title: Correct Velvet Acorn inherited account name
tickets.text: Address the Velvet Acorn Custody name correction so the inherited account service record uses Lydia Cloudpuddle rather than Lydia Velvetreed, since the mismatch may prevent acceptance of inherited account paperwork unless the custodian corrects the registration workflow.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to address the name correction by 2025-08-04.
